errors.text: The proposed GAP/SNAP model and vaguely defined Frenkel–Ladd or simplified-TI path do not reconstruct the target intervention: a moment tensor potential used as the reference for direct MTP-to-DFT free-energy perturbation.

Training the potential exclusively on above-melting liquid configurations is incompatible with using it to obtain both solid and liquid free energies and creates an uncontrolled extrapolation for the solid phase.

The mechanism incorrectly frames the perturbation as connecting a solid reference to the liquid. In the target method, FEP corrects MTP-sampled phase free energies to DFT because the MTP and DFT phase-space distributions overlap and their energy-difference variance is small.
The cited evidence does not substantiate the proposed machine-learning-potential/FEP intervention, its accuracy thresholds, or its claimed 10–100-fold speedup.
